title: Restormel route step rich metadata
description: Optional JSON blobs stored on route_steps and echoed in resolve stepChain (contract 2026-04-14+). Additional properties are allowed for forward compatibility.

switchCriteria.description: Switch hints; hosts interpret. Optional `advanceOn` lists suggested failure kinds to advance to the next tier.

advanceOn.description: Suggested failure kinds that mean "try next tier". Echoed on resolve `stepChain` as `advanceOn` when set. Hosts interpret freely. **Hosted runtime** (`POST …/runtime/invoke`) honours only allowlisted tokens (`error`, `rate_limit`, `no_key`, `policy_block`, `any`) for upstream-failure advance; see `runtimeSwitchEvalVersion`.

retryOn.description: Suggested failure kinds to retry on same tier before advancing (host interpretation).

modelPool.description: Model pool v1 (stored in route_steps.model_pool). Resolver picks first eligible member after ordering; must not contain secrets.
